meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 它把消息渠道接到 agent 分组上:创建分组与接线、设置隔离级别和会话模式,还能列出已接、已配置未接、未配置的渠道以及权限用户。
howto.when: 在添加渠道之后、安装配置过程中,或想单独重新配置渠道接线时使用。

say.text: 帮我看看现在哪些渠道已经接好了、哪些还没接。
把这个新建的 Telegram 群接到我的 agent 分组上。
say.note: 会先问你选哪种隔离级别

say.text: 把这个渠道的接线改到另一个 agent 分组。
say.note: 已有会话仍留在原分组

howto.what_en: Wires messaging channels to agent groups: creates groups and wiring rows, sets isolation levels and session modes, and lists wired, configured-but-unwired and unconfigured channels plus privileged users.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure existing channel wiring.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which are not.
Wire this new Telegram group to my agent group.
Move this channel's wiring to another agent group.
